author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
Replaces the `any` usages that had real types available, and leaves alone the ones that don't.

The repo has 24 `any` occurrences. Auditing them turned out to matter more than fixing them: 16 are load-bearing, and a blanket cleanup would have made three of them worse.

## Changed

### `(error as any).exitCode` — 4 sites in `apps/moo-dang/src/shell/commands.ts`

`createShellCommandError` attaches `command` and `exitCode` via `Object.defineProperty` but declared its return type as plain `Error`, so every consumer had to cast to reach the fields it had just set.

Adds an exported `ShellCommandError` interface and an `isShellCommandError` guard, and narrows both factory return types. Consumers go from:

```ts
if (error instanceof Error && 'exitCode' in error && typeof (error as any).exitCode === 'number') {
  return createCommandResult(context, `...`, '', error.message, (error as any).exitCode, startTime)
}
```

to:

```ts
if (isShellCommandError(error)) {
  return createCommandResult(context, `...`, '', error.message, error.exitCode, startTime)
}
```

One assertion remains, at each factory's `return` — that is the single place the shape is actually constructed, and `Object.defineProperty` is invisible to the type system.

### `configManager.reset(options.section as any)`

`options.section` is a `string` straight from user input; `reset` takes a union of section literals. The cast was papering over a missing validation step, so an unknown section reached the config manager instead of producing an error.

Now validated through a type guard, returning a proper command error that matches the existing `config list: section '...' not found` style. This is the one intentional behavior change here — invalid input now fails cleanly rather than being asserted past.

The section list was previously a local array inside `_formatFullConfig`. It is now a module-level `CONFIG_SECTION_NAMES` shared by validation and display, declared as: [description truncated to fit budget]
title: refactor(types): replace actionable any usages with precise types
